newsitem.title: USA: CME April live cattle rise to new high, feeders up.
newsitem.headline: CME April live cattle rise to new high, feeders up.

text.p: CME live cattle futures opened higher and spot April set a new contract high while feeder cattle also started higher.
Carryover demand prompted by a strong tone to cash markets lifted live cattle futures initially, but profit taking quickly developed to ease prices back to near unchanged levels, traders said.
Feeder cattle futures also rose with lower corn futures indications cited as supportive, traders said.
At 0908 CDT, live cattle stood unchanged to 0.050 cent higher with June up 0.050 at 65.300 cents.
Feeder cattle were 0.025 to 0.175 higher with May up 0.025 at 71.675 cents.
